_about: Inner tools of PostHog's hosted exec tool, from PostHog/posthog services/mcp/schema/tool-definitions-all.json (master, 2026-10-20). Each entry is [readOnlyHint as PostHog marks it, verdict Maskin expects for a Read agent]. A read verdict is only allowed where PostHog also marks the tool read-only; a write verdict on a tool PostHog marks read-only is a deliberate miss (fail closed). Refresh by re-exporting that file and reviewing every changed verdict.
